newsitem.title: UK: LME copper builds on earlier gains in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper builds on earlier gains in late trading.

text.p: LME copper prices nudged higher in late inter-office activity on Monday after a tight trading day with widespread buying.
At 1800 GMT three months copper was indicated at $2,416/18 per tonne, slightly extending its afternoon peak of $2,415. It closed the kerb at $2,409, a gain of $19 on the day.
Analysts said there was still potential for nearby tightness which could boost prices further. The next big upside target on the charts is $2,440.
"With bullish sentiment gaining momentum and with a strong technical picture emerging, we favour the upside for the short-medium term," said brokerage Rudolf Wolff in its evening report.
Wolff said it would not be surprised to see prices extend their 1997 rally.
Aluminium also hovered around its close of $1,670, $8 up on the day, after an earlier peak of $1,679. It was last indicated at $1,671/75.
